args.question: What is the cardholder statement for this dispute?

args.narrative: Authenticity proof and product description for the item are attached, with the approved authorization (code 973696) and receipt. The cardholder statement (cancelled and still charged) does not concern counterfeit goods; I hold no cancellation record.

args.explanation: Read the case, statement and all four evidence documents. Represented with authenticity_proof and product_description (the required kinds), plus authorization record and receipt. The issuer accepted and the chargeback was reversed. I paid the 1500 chargeback fee. No refund issued.
